# Entangled Causal Witnesses

The repository studies initial-entanglement requirements for reduced temporal pseudo-density-matrix witnesses of signalling in a fixed noisy Bell-effect channel.

## Authoritative reading routes

- README.md: scientific question, central uniform law, scope and navigation.
- science/README.md: connected overview of the complete argument.
- science/model.md: dimensions, channel, coarse sequential measurements, PDM normalization, Schmidt-number budget and no-false-positive boundary.
- science/schmidt_law.md: authoritative finite upper/lower bounds and proof of the matching-order dimension/Schmidt-number/noise law; even/odd/product boundary cases.
- science/entanglement_cost.md: Bell-overlap and relative-entropy derivation of a single-preparation entanglement-of-formation lower bound.
- science/witness.md: attaining balanced-state family, two-setting estimator, distinction between baseline and measured contexts, constructive precision bound.
- science/implementation.md: explicit qubit preparation, joint Bell test, final-bit noise model, gates/workspace and ideal-operation assumptions.
- science/interpretation.md: physical meaning, inherited ingredients, normalization and sampling limits.
- references/RELATED_WORK.md and references/references.bib: primary-source attribution and model/theorem comparisons.
- verification/README.md: reproduction command, actual finite checks and evidence limits.
- learning/README.md: entrypoint to the one-anchor learning route.
- learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md: verified Watrous2018 foundation pointers, notation dictionary and missing research steps.
- learning/WORKED_EXAMPLE.md: a complete six-qubit, one-noisy-bit experiment with positive physical probabilities and a two-context temporal witness.
- learning/MILESTONES.md: exactly30 common understanding targets M01–M30 in background and narrative phases, with dependencies and source pointers.

## Claim discipline

Use f(R)=||R||_1-1, twice ordinary trace negativity. For q<=q0<1/2, the optimized value under initial Schmidt number k is Theta_{q0}(k^2/[d(k+qd)]). The bound covers arbitrary mixed Schmidt-number-k inputs, not only a displayed pure family. The displayed family matches order; its exact value is not the all-input optimum.

The reported noise acts on one final bit, not every internal detector or gate. Both A and B enter the known joint apparatus. Initial entanglement changes accessible causal influence and is charged. Entanglement of formation is not silently the regularized asymptotic cost. No universal sample-complexity or algorithmic-advantage claim is made. Negative temporal-witness expectation is reconstructed from distinct contexts and is not a negative physical joint probability.
